performance.verdict: Meta driving all 19 leads; Google spend unaccountable, pipeline intake broken.

findings.text: 5 overdue SOW milestones (Pre-Launch Stack, LSA Verification, Site Live, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting) remain uncleared as of 2026-09-15, blocking attribution integrity.
Google Ads consumed $2,257.98 over 28 days; GA4 records 0 conversions and GHL shows 0 won opportunities — spend is unaccountable to any signed-case signal.

CPL collapsed 68.8% week-over-week to $160.63, driven entirely by Meta's 19 leads on $794.06 spend; 3-day lead signal (Sep 12–14: 4 leads) vs prior 3 days (Sep 9–11: 8 leads) shows a pullback, suggesting the surge may not hold.
GHL shows 82 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won cases; 207 contacts vs 19 tracked leads implies intake routing or speed-to-lead is broken, not an ads volume problem.
GBP actions fell 55.1% week-over-week; last 2 days in series show 0 GBP actions, while IG reach held at 767–884 — organic search presence is softening independent of paid.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no scale decisions are defensible without attribution stack live.
